$comment: Advisories `npm audit` may report without failing CI.
Every entry needs a reason and a removeWhen condition — an unexplained
allowlist entry is indistinguishable from an unnoticed vulnerability.
Consumed by scripts/check-audit.mjs. Anything NOT listed here still
fails the build, so this narrows the gate rather than disabling it.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2.title: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2.reason: Not exploitable here: the advisory is specific to React Server Components mode, and this frontend is a client-only Vite SPA. src/main.tsx mounts <BrowserRouter> (not a data/RSC router), there is no SSR entrypoint, no @react-router/* server packages, and no createStaticHandler/renderToPipeableStream in src/. There is no server-side action pipeline for the bypass to act on.
GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2.deferredBecause: The fix is react-router-dom 7.x -> 8.3.0, a major upgrade across 25+ dashboard routes. Its regression surface is materially larger than this exposure, so it is tracked as planned work.
